calls.title: MQL / Lead Assignment
calls.summary: The team discussed a structured approach for routing marketing qualified leads (MQLs) and assigning them to sales representatives, highlighting the importance of clear triggers and workflows in HubSpot. They acknowledged current limitations in the routing process, especially the need for granularity based on geography and employee size. A third-party routing tool was identified as necessary to maintain UTM attribution and enhance lead data. Additionally, the team examined issues related to account ownership, emphasizing the need for proper alignment with active deals to streamline processes. Updates on product pricing and tier management were made, addressing concerns about user limits in the free tier and the necessity for better tracking. They also explored sales and marketing workflow automation to improve lead tracking and communication, while defining segments to enhance lead assignment and outbound targeting.
calls.keywords: Lead Assignment, HubSpot Workflows, Demo Routing, Account Ownership, MQL Definition, Segmentation
